content: Dev Chatterjee called insurance agent Anita Sharma to inquire about extending his travel policy ending on 30/09/2026. Anita informed him that expired policies cannot be extended and result in a lapse with no refund, but offered to issue a new policy for the next period. Dev asked about keeping the same policy number and activation details, and Anita explained that a new ID would be assigned and the new policy would activate upon quote acceptance and payment starting 01/10/2026.

action_items: Anita Sharma to send a quote for a new travel plan
Dev Chatterjee to review the new quote
